# StateStream — AL102 lab (SnapTrips vector skin)

**Repo:** [`aaron-devx/statestream-al102`](https://github.com/aaron-devx/statestream-al102) · branch **`al102-automata`** for class work, **`master`** for travel-only baseline.

Run with any static server from this folder, e.g. `python3 -m http.server 5500`, then open http://localhost:5500

* All art is hand-authored inline SVG generated by the Python scripts in `source/` (no raster images).
* Motion: CSS keyframes on SVG groups (birds, clouds, smoke, foliage, water) + Lenis 1.3.4 smooth scroll
  and GSAP 3.13 ScrollTrigger (hero parallax, reveals) loaded from CDN. Without the CDN the page still
  renders and the CSS loops still run. `prefers-reduced-motion` turns motion off.
* Regenerate: `cd source && python3 hero.py && python3 scenes.py && python3 build_site.py`
  (writes svg/*.svg, index.html and main.js into the parent folder).

## AL102 branch (`al102-automata`)

* **Lab UI:** `al102/index.html` — DFA/NFA string checker (prof slides Week 7 / 10).
* Serve from repo root: `python3 -m http.server 5500` → http://localhost:5500/al102/
